# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts, often grinning and chuckling without being able to think of a reply until it is too late. He is timid around social events to the point of decamping for fear of being invited to supper with strangers, yet he takes pride when accompanying someone he admires.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Big and stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Lacks conversational skills  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Shy and easily intimidated by social invitations  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a team and buggy  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

Billy lived in Avonlea with his family, including his sisters Jane and Alice. When a concert was held at the White Sands Hotel, he drove his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry over in his family's double-seated buggy. He insisted that Anne sit beside him on the front seat, being puffed up with pride to drive with her despite his inability to keep up conversation. While the girls attended the concert and supper, Billy decamped in fear of being invited to join the event with strangers, but he waited outside with the team to drive the girls safely home in the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
